skeleton.name: MPFB2 game_engine (Unreal-mannequin names) + eye_l, eye_r
skeleton.axes: glTF: +Y up, the character faces +Z, metres

tint.convention: the top garment is its own primitive with a material named `tint_top` (extras.tint = "top"). Its texture there is neutral light grey with the cloth shading only; multiply it by a club colour with material.color.set(colour). The exported colour is just a default.

regions.tint_top: the outer top (a jacket, where there is one)
regions.tint_trim: collar and cuffs of a top without a jacket (a band about 2 cm wide)

tint.stripes: every tinted primitive carries a second UV set (TEXCOORD_1, Blender name tint_uv): u runs round the body (0.5 = front centre, 0/1 = back centre), v = 0 at the hip joints and 1 at the shoulder joints. For hoops, a texture with horizontal bands on texture.channel = 1 with RepeatWrapping (repeat.y = number of hoops); for vertical stripes, bands along u. Sleeves follow the body's height, so hoops run round them too.

accessories.convention: optional meshes inside each character GLB, skinned 100 % to the head bone (facial hair also carries the mouth and jaw morphs): Acc_cap_flat, Acc_beanie, Acc_glasses_round, Acc_glasses_square and, for adults, Acc_moustache and Acc_beard; Hair2 is a second hairstyle (adults), Hair_hat is the hair pressed under a hat. Node extras.accessory names them. Hide them all on load (mesh.visible = false) and show the ones an instance wears; with a hat show Hair_hat instead of Hair.
accessories.licence: modelled by script in scripts/life/assets/refine.py (no CC0 cap, beanie or glasses asset of acceptable quality was in the packs), fitted to each head

lod.convention: cast/<id>-lod1.glb: the same 55-bone skeleton (the same clips play), one mesh, one material, about 4k triangles, a 512 px atlas; the tint regions are in COLOR_0 (R top, G inner, B trim). Colour it with a shader that mixes the club colour in by that mask, e.g. onBeforeCompile: diffuseColor.rgb *= mix(vec3(1.), uTop, vColor.r) * mix(vec3(1.), uInner, vColor.g) * mix(vec3(1.), uTrim, vColor.b) (and keep vertexColors off so the mask itself does not tint).

face.morphTargets: ARKit face units (52 names, MPFB faceunits01, CC0) and Meta/Oculus visemes (viseme_*, MPFB visemes02, CC0), on Head, Lashes, Brows, Teeth, Tongue; set the same influence by name on every mesh that has it
face.eyes: bones eye_l and eye_r turn the eyeballs; the eyeLook* morphs move the lids with them

lod1.tintMask: COLOR_0: R = tint_top, G = tint_inner, B = tint_trim (1 = club colour), A = 1

restingFace.note: already folded into the base shape; leave every morph at 0 for the resting face

sources.what: accessories (caps, glasses, facial hair), LOD, teeth reduction, brow thickening
sources.licence: made by script in scripts/life/assets/refine.py (this repository), from the CC0 parts above

assets.contacts: locomotion clips: contacts.l / contacts.r = heel-strike frames, stance = [strike, toe-off] frames, speed = ground speed in m/s for the reference body (scale by hipHeight); walk and run start on the left heel at frame 0
assets.pairs: two-person clips: pair.<other>.at = (x metres to the left, metres forward, yaw degrees) of the other body's root in this body's frame, or an attach rule (bone, offset)

clips.name: idle
clips.what: standing: breathing and a slow shift of weight

clips.name: idle_2
clips.what: standing on the left leg, right hand on the hip, a look to the side

clips.name: idle_3
clips.what: feet apart, hands held loosely in front, scanning the crowd

clips.name: walk
clips.what: one captured stride, in place (CMU mocap, averaged); left heel strikes at frame 0

clips.name: run
clips.what: one captured running stride, in place (CMU mocap, averaged); left foot lands at frame 0

clips.name: carry
clips.what: the captured walk with both arms holding a box

clips.name: walk_child
clips.what: a child's walk: quicker, bouncier, bigger arm swing; left heel at frame 0

clips.name: hold_hand_walk_adult
clips.what: adult and child walking hand in hand (child at the adult's right, 52 cm across): two adult strides = three child strides

clips.name: hold_hand_walk_child
clips.what: adult and child walking hand in hand (child at the adult's right, 52 cm across): two adult strides = three child strides

clips.name: turn
clips.what: a quarter turn to the left in two steps (Root turns 90 degrees)

clips.name: step_turn_l
clips.what: a quarter turn in two steps, head first, trunk then feet (Root turns 90 degrees)

clips.name: talk_1
clips.what: talking: open hands

clips.name: talk_2
clips.what: talking: one hand explains

clips.name: talk_3
clips.what: talking: a shrug, then pointing ahead

clips.name: wave
clips.what: right arm up, waving

clips.name: cheer
clips.what: both fists up, bouncing: a goal

clips.name: laugh_body
clips.what: a laugh through the whole body: back, folding forward in bursts, a hand to the belly

clips.name: sit
clips.what: stand to seated (seat at knee height), then held

clips.name: sit_play_board
clips.what: seated at a table (top 0.72 m, board 40 cm ahead): takes a piece, moves it, looks up

clips.name: lean_on_rail
clips.what: forearms on a rail (top 1.05 m, 40 cm ahead), one foot crossed

clips.name: crouch_to_child
clips.what: down on one knee to a child's eye level, then held

clips.name: hand_on_shoulder
clips.what: right hand out and down onto the shoulder of a child standing at the right side, then held

clips.name: hug
clips.what: both arms round someone in front, then held

clips.name: ruffle_hair
clips.what: standing at a child's left (child 1.35 m, 35 cm to the right, 30 cm ahead): the right hand ruffles the child's hair

clips.name: put_scarf_on
clips.what: kneeling in front of a child (50 cm ahead, facing): a scarf round the neck with both hands, a pat, hands to the shoulders

clips.name: child_on_shoulders_carrier
clips.what: a child on the shoulders: the carrier holds the shins; the rider holds the head and waves once

clips.name: child_on_shoulders_rider
clips.what: a child on the shoulders: the carrier holds the shins; the rider holds the head and waves once

clips.name: kick_ball
clips.what: a child's kick with the right foot; the foot meets the ball at 0.70 s

clips.name: hug_partner
clips.what: two adults embracing (both play this clip, facing, roots 42 cm apart): right arm over the shoulder, left round the waist, a sway, two pats

clips.name: hug_partner_adult
clips.what: an adult down on one knee and a child of about 1.35 m embracing (facing, roots 46 cm apart)

clips.name: hug_partner_child
clips.what: an adult down on one knee and a child of about 1.35 m embracing (facing, roots 46 cm apart)

clips.name: hand_relaxed
clips.what: hand shape "relaxed" on both hands: finger bones only, for an override or additive layer

clips.name: hand_fist
clips.what: hand shape "fist" on both hands: finger bones only, for an override or additive layer

clips.name: hand_point
clips.what: hand shape "point" on both hands: finger bones only, for an override or additive layer

clips.name: hand_thumb_up
clips.what: hand shape "thumb_up" on both hands: finger bones only, for an override or additive layer

clips.name: hand_palm_down_rest
clips.what: hand shape "palm_down_rest" on both hands: finger bones only, for an override or additive layer

clips.name: step_turn_r
clips.what: a quarter turn in two steps, head first, trunk then feet (Root turns 90 degrees)

assets.tracks: bone rotations (parent space) for every bone, and the position of `pelvis` only; scale the pelvis position by character.hipHeight / clips.hipHeight
